lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Town Council's October 27 meeting, where three consequential items land at once: a Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA committing to 2027 cost-sharing, plus first readings of ordinances touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program and at least one other code change. Before that, P&Z on October 22 takes up the long-delayed Shandoka Lot Preliminary PUD at 860 Black Bear Rd — a proposal to redevelop Town-owned property with increased dimensional limits — and the Hospital District board considers possible action on a Two Site Model that could reshape how and where this valley receives medical care.

notable.stake: Board may vote on a Two Site Model affecting how the valley receives healthcare.
Feasibility vote on Lots 1007/1008 and childcare/arts funding decisions on the table.
Preliminary PUD hearing for Town-owned land at 860 Black Bear Rd; dimensional limits may increase.
Variance request to reduce required setback on a Mountain Village parcel goes to a vote.
Council votes on gondola cost-sharing IGA and takes first readings on two ordinances.
